title: Design Splitwise
summary: Track shared expenses across four split types where every split sums exactly to the total, keep one net balance per person instead of a debt matrix, and settle the whole group in at most n-1 payments.
concepts: Integer money, and why floats break ledgers slowly
The largest remainder method for splits that do not divide evenly
Net balances instead of a who-owes-whom matrix
Greedy debt settlement, its n-1 bound, and why the true minimum is NP-hard
Freezing derived values so history cannot be rewritten
extensions: Support multiple currencies and decide which exchange rate applies
Add groups, and decide whether balances are per group or global
Allow editing and deleting past expenses
Rotate who absorbs the rounding remainder across expenses
Restrict settlement suggestions to within a group
